summary: Comprehensive test of Fantasy page (empty + roster-aware), PlayerDetail (skater/goalie/404/similar-nav), Stats->Player row-link round-trip, and backend Sportradar fallback endpoints. All 10 review criteria PASS.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by build-tool x-ve-dynamic instrumentation wrapping option text nodes. Non-blocking (functionality works) but produces noisy console warnings.

backend.GET /api/stats/players: PASS - 200, source=mock, 10 players incl. mcdavid & hellebuyck

test_results.frontend_fantasy_empty: PASS - all 5 new panels render (health-score, host-take-reggie, host-take-marc, waivers, injuries, line-alert). start-sit correctly absent. Health shows '—'.
test_results.frontend_fantasy_filled: PASS - after adding McDavid/Makar/Hellebuyck: start-sit appears, score=67 (in 15-98 range), grade letter present, both hosts render context-aware takes.

test_results.player_detail_goalie: PASS - top-stats show SV%/GAA (no G/A/PTS). Rank badges 'in sv%' and 'in wins'. Reggie mentions workhorse/sv%. Marc references sv%, GAA.
test_results.player_detail_404: PASS - '/player/nonexistent-id' shows 'PLAYER NOT FOUND' fallback + working 'GO BACK' button (no white-screen)
test_results.similar_player_nav: PASS - clicked similar card, navigated /player/mcdavid -> /player/mackinnon, new hero rendered
test_results.back_to_stats_roundtrip: PASS - back link returns to /stats without white-screen

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) The Stats page <select><option> markup triggers a React hydration warning because build tooling injects <span> children into <option>. Consider suppressing x-ve-dynamic instrumentation on <option> tags. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: PlayerDetail.jsx line ~62: `((sv / sa) * 1000 / 1000).toFixed(3)` is a no-op multiply/divide — should just be `(sv / sa).toFixed(3)`. Cosmetic.

Fantasy.jsx `hostTakes(...)` — reggie/marc takes don't include the roster's team callout in the empty-state OR when grade is 'C' range (the fav-team template only fires when favorite_teams[0] is set). Current review criterion 'both takes contain player's team callout or roster-context language' passes because the language ('HOCKEY roster', PP1, etc.) is roster-context, but if the requirement was literal team codes it would need a rewrite.
PlayerDetail.jsx: unused imports `Target`, `Shield` (Shield is unused). Minor lint.
